output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The requirement of '_value > 0 && _value <= balances[msg.sender]' is not met when _value is at the smallest value a uint256 can represent, causing an overflow in the balances[msg.sender] -= _value; balances[_to] += _value; statements, granting arbitrary balance to recipients.

The 'batchTransfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'cnt' is large, 'amount' = 'cnt * _value' will cause an overflow, allowing the batch transfer function to be locked out of the contract due to integer overflow.
The 'approve' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'cnt' is large, 'amount' = 'cnt * _value' will cause an overflow, reducing the owner's balance to a large negative value.
